item.title: Version 1.1.9
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.9

  • Isolated Development Data: Development builds now store databases, caches, and Keychain items in an isolated sandbox, preventing test data or migrations from affecting production portfolios.
  • Pinned Watchlist Symbol Column: The symbol and name column remains fixed while scrolling wide metrics horizontally.
  • Market Quote Accuracy: Prevented Yahoo WebSocket ticks from overriding Vietnamese stock prices and Japanese mutual funds.
